title: Lightweight interop likelihood matrix
body:
Purpose: quick, low-friction table to estimate the likelihood and operational impact surface across teams for the upcoming lightweight batching pilot. Use this to prioritize follow-ups, owners, and immediate mitigations. Not exhaustive — deliberately compact (two-pager equivalent).

Assumptions:
- Pilot affects one hosted model family (gpt-small-ish variant) and a single latency SLO lane (p99 <= 420ms).
- Autoscaling policies unchanged for pilot window; only batching params tuned.
- We care about customer-visible latency regressions, controller-level errors, and cost delta for short-run sizing.

Columns: component | owner | likelihood_of_impact | estimated_effort_hours (mitigation) | mitigation_plan | followup_action | priority | notes

Rows:
1) Serving runtime (request router + batching loop) | eng-serving-runtime | High | 16 | Decrease default batch window, enable prefix caching for host-models | Add canary with 10% traffic; run 30m synthetic load profile before rollout | P0 | Historic hotspot for small-seq requests; batching increases p50 benefits but can spike p99 if KV miss patterns shift.

2) KV cache (redis-tier + local sticky-store) | infrastructure | Medium | 12 | Add KV hit-rate monitoring and 5m retention rollback knob | Pager on >10% drop in KV hit-rate during canary | P1 | Concern: new batching may increase lookups; infra could throttle.

3) Console and rollouts (UI + rollout orchestration) | product-console | Medium | 8 | Add rollout toggle and quick revert button; surface per-route latency deltas | Create a one-click revert runbook for SEs | P1 | UI already has route-level traces but not per-batch-window breakdown.

4) Observability (dashboards + alerts) | engineering-observability | High | 10 | Add temporary dashboards: per-model p50/p95/p99 by batch-size; token cost per-min | Alert: p99 up >15% for 10m -> notify SRE & runtime | P0 | Need to instrument batch-size tag through request path; small engineering task.

5) Dedicated capacity (reserved clusters) | product-dedicated | Low | 6 | Validate autoscale policies respect new request shapes; pre-warm nodes during canary | Add load-generator to dedicated test cluster | P2 | Dedicated customers might see different behavior; flag for targeted outreach if we observe regression.

6) Private deployments (VPC installable package) | private-deployments | Low | 20 | Draft advisory and release notes; provide opt-out knob in config | Post-release checklist to notify SEs of optional revert property | P2 | On-prem customers require guidance; may choose to skip pilot entirely.

7) SRE / runbooks | site-reliability-engineering | High | 12 | Update runbooks with batching-specific escalations and rollback steps | Schedule 1-hr runbook readout pre-canary | P0 | SREs need visibility into model fallback and backpressure signals.

8) Developer experience / SDKs | developer-experience | Medium | 8 | Ensure SDKs propagate batch metadata; add simple example for batch tuning | Quick PR to SDK repo to add batch-size trace header | P1 | SDKs currently strip unknown headers; small change.

Quick synthesis and recommended next steps (short list):
- Prep canary: serving-runtime + observability + SRE (P0 trio). Schedule canary next Tue 10:00-12:00 PT.
- Instrumentation tasks: obs team to add batch-size tags and dashboard before canary (ETA 48h).
- Small infra safeguard: infra to add KV hit-rate alert and temporary throttle knob.
- Console: add visible rollout revert button and an on-screen note for SEs (low-effort).
- Communication: one short note to Dedicated and Private SEs describing pilot opt-in/opt-out.

Open questions / unresolved items (to triage in async thread):
- Expected cost delta for token-level billing: finance to provide rough per-hour burn estimate for pilot at 10% traffic. (Assigned: Rafael)
- Does the model catalog need a flagged property for batching-unsafe models? If yes, add to model-onboarding checklist. (Assigned: Priya)
- Synthetic workload definitions: who owns canonical synthetic scenarios for canary? (Assigned: Aisha)

Mini action timeline (this doc is a living tracker — update statuses directly):
- T-72h: Observability dashboard skeleton (in progress) -> obs owner: Aisha.
- T-48h: Canaries configured on runtime cluster, KV alert set -> infra owner: Rafael.
- T-24h: Rollout page + revert button added -> console owner: Priya.
- Canary day: 10:00 start, 10% traffic, 30m steady-state, evaluate metrics, escalate if p99 > baseline*1.15.

Notes to self: keep this intentionally terse; if we expand into a long-run program, migrate into product-ops canonical tracker. For now, this sheet is the single source for cross-team immediate actions.

Document history:
- 2027-06-12: initial draft (Jordan)
- 2027-06-13: added obs rows and canary cadence (Aisha)
- 2027-06-15: updated priority and action owners after sync (Rafael, Priya)

End.
